description: (needs account token) Returns a payment link for a domain on one of the account's sites. The account holder opens and pays the link. After payment the domain goes live on that site with no DNS settings. For a site that is not on the account yet, the claim happens first. Does not charge a card.

extras.description: Optional extra domain names on the same payment.

site.description: The address of the site the domain attaches to, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get checkout link
